description.value:
Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Furrykin (Ursid) while converting it from a lineage-species into a heritage.

“Talking animals? Sure. But you’re not a joke. You’re a survival story with teeth.”

Furrykin (Ursid). The Shattering didn’t uplift you. It removed the last excuses. You were always people; the world just finally admitted it.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Clade Lean. Your clade leans toward STR—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Wildframe & Instinct

At creation you gain Wildframe & Instinct (Wildframe, Keen Sense, Clade Instinct, Pack/Trouble Magnet).

Ursid Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17).

Note: This species uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Furrykin wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.

advancement.title: Ursid Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Ursid Tier I clade power.
